_comment: Category-B (weak-copyleft) dependencies allowed by exception under P17 / ADR-0004. Each entry is a deliberate, isolated, reviewed allowance — NOT a place to silence Cat-X (GPL/AGPL/source-available). `package` is matched by exact name OR name-prefix (covers per-platform variants). gate:licenses fails on any Cat-B dep not listed here.

categoryB.reason: libvips native binary behind `sharp`. LGPL is weak copyleft; it is used unmodified and dynamically linked (a separate .dylib/.so loaded at runtime, never statically bundled into our JS), so it qualifies as FINOS/ASF Category B. It enters transitively via @huggingface/transformers' IMAGE pipeline; Munshi's mixed lane is AUDIO-only and never instantiates it.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception AND pruned from the deployment artifact (`--no-optional` / omit @img/sharp-*), so no LGPL binary ships.

categoryB.reason: Native CSS transform/minification engine used by the Next/Tailwind toolchain. MPL applies to the unmodified dependency files, not to Munshi source or generated CSS.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; dependency remains an isolated build/runtime package managed by pnpm.
categoryB.scope: frontend build pipeline and Next CSS handling (pnpm workspace; andai/portal's Tailwind CSS build via npm, build stage only — not in the portal image)

categoryB.reason: PostgreSQL driver (psycopg 3, with its psycopg-binary wheel) used by andai-core through SQLAlchemy. LGPL is weak copyleft; the library is used unmodified as a separately installed Python package loaded at runtime, never copied into or statically linked with munshi.ai source, so it qualifies as FINOS/ASF Category B.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; installed unmodified from PyPI into the andai-core image's virtualenv (and the andai-worker and andai-intake virtualenvs, which carry andai-core's dependencies), where it stays replaceable by the user.

categoryB.reason: Mozilla's CA certificate bundle, a required dependency of httpx, which andai-core uses to call the meeting platform's admin-api. MPL-2.0 is file-level weak copyleft; the package is used unmodified as a separately installed Python package (a data file plus a path lookup), never copied into munshi.ai source, so it qualifies as FINOS/ASF Category B.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; installed unmodified from PyPI into the andai-core image's virtualenv (and the andai-worker and andai-intake virtualenvs, which carry andai-core's dependencies).

categoryB.reason: Text layout library WeasyPrint loads through cffi to print minutes PDFs. It comes from Debian bookworm (libpango-1.0-0, libpangoft2-1.0-0) with the LGPL-2.1-or-later runtime libraries it depends on: libglib2.0-0, libfribidi0, libthai0, libthai-data, libdatrie1, and libgraphite2-3 (LGPL-2.1-or-later OR GPL-2.0-or-later OR MPL-1.1, used under the LGPL). All are unmodified system shared libraries, dynamically loaded at runtime and never copied into or statically linked with munshi.ai code, so they qualify as FINOS/ASF Category B.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; installed unmodified with apt in the andai-core image's runtime stage (andai/services/core/Dockerfile), each with its Debian copyright file under /usr/share/doc, replaceable by the user.
categoryB.scope: andai/services/core (andai-core image, minutes PDF export only; andai-worker does not install them)

categoryB.reason: Hyphenation library and dictionaries, a required dependency of WeasyPrint. It is tri-licensed and used under the LGPL-2.1-or-later / MPL-1.1 option: an unmodified, separately installed Python package loaded at runtime, never copied into munshi.ai source. That qualifies as FINOS/ASF Category B; the GPL option is not relied on.
categoryB.disposition: Logged exception; installed unmodified from PyPI into the andai-core (and andai-worker and andai-intake, which carry andai-core's dependencies but never render a PDF) virtualenv.
